blocks.text: 2. EXECUTE presentation — eighteen proxies confirmed

• The project uses exactly eighteen generic execution presentation proxies: Normal, Fire, Water, Electric, Grass, Ice, Fighting, Poison, Ground, Flying, Psychic, Bug, Rock, Ghost, Dragon, Dark, Steel and Fairy.
• The proxy is selected deterministically from the executing Abyssal's primary / Type 1.
• Dual typing creates no player choice and no RNG roll.
• The proxy represents the actual active Abyssal narratively; it is not a separate creature.
• No 187-species execution-sprite set is required.
3. Human restoration — corrected final rule
Human restoration is an authored finale/postgame exception separate from the Civeton Abyssal memorial. There are exactly five total human restoration uses, and every use is elective.

blocks.text: • Pate and Trade are not automatically restored.
• The player may restore neither, one, or both.
• Each eligible human consumes exactly one of the five uses.
• The same human cannot consume a second use.
• The player is never required to spend all five uses.
• Unused capacity disappears and cannot become money, items, Abyssal resurrection, Trial Marks, stat bonuses or any other reward.
• Restoration does not erase historical death, execution or memorial records.
